title: Understanding the Momentum-Resolved Phonon EELS Signal Through Multi-Modal Simulation
content: As advances are made in energy and momentum resolution, EELS is becoming a valuable tool for the measurement of phonon band structure and properties. Recent works have developed tools for simulating the phononic signals acquired during these measurements [1, 2], however features in both simulated results and data remain unexplained. We thus incorporate Spectral Energy Density (SED) and Lattice Dynamics (LD) calculations to understand the phonon behavior of two model systems (silicon, and aluminum nitride). This allows separation of the fundamental behavior of phonons vs. the fast electron / phonon interactions and scattering.
